facts.fact: The World Bank project paper of June 2023 names the Ministry of Health's Directorate of Planning and Information as responsible for the annual HMIS reports drawn from DHIS2 and for reviewing the DHIS2 database for the timeliness and completeness of public health facilities' monthly reports.

The World Bank states that the weekly surveillance returns, the most timely structured reporting in the country, are tallied on paper on the IDSR Weekly Reporting Form and then entered at the regional level into the DHIS2 aggregate platform; this is said of weekly disease surveillance, not of the monthly facility report.

The World Bank states that the Bluesquare contract for the electronic National Health Insurance System, under its Essential Health Services Strengthening Project, was amended to include an electronic health records system using OpenClinic.

As of June 2023 the World Bank describes the OpenClinic electronic health records system as still to be piloted, in the same four health facilities as the electronic National Health Insurance System; it reports no facility using it.
